title: Extrinsic Evaluation of Cultural Competence in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the correlation between the text similarity (BLEU scores) of model outputs for different countries and the cultural values of those countries as quantified by cross-cultural psychology surveys (Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions and the World Values Survey).

Perturbing explicit nationality cues in prompt templates for open-ended question answering and story generation tasks, then quantitatively analyzing lexical variance (word edit distance) and qualitatively analyzing the use of culturally relevant vocabulary via TF-IDF.
